comment: Engine choices of SlicerX for an opened project. keeps: stay when a project opens, unless the person changed them in the project (its different_settings_to_system lists the key); over, when given, names the only inherited values a keep replaces, so any other value the project inherited stays its own (a project that does not set the key still gets the keep); note says what the open kept when the project's inherited value differs. defaults: apply only when the project does not set the key at all; a value the project sets is its own. fromApp: by the app that wrote the file (the model's Application metadata starts with the name), its reading of keys its project lacks: each applies only when the project does not set the key, nor any key in unlessAny. The app, the MCP server (engine-choices.ts) and sx slice <project.3mf> (sx-core, through build.rs) all read this file. value: what SlicerX prints with.

wall_generator.note: Kept SlicerX's aegis walls; the project used Bambu's default.

initial_layer_travel_acceleration.note: Bambu Studio reads a missing first layer travel acceleration as 500 mm/s2, not as a share of the travel acceleration.

internal_bridge_speed.note: Its presets have no internal bridge speed, and it prints internal bridges at the bridge speed, not our 150 percent.

wipe_tower_wall_type.note: A project saved before the rib wall switch existed has neither key: the rib wall, that app's default.
